# Expected — 04 check-cashing-onboarding

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | scam |
| Family | Jobs |
| Expected label | **Scam markers: 3 or more** |
| Recovery branch | no |
| Purpose | The fraudulent-check flow dressed as generosity: a "bonus" that becomes a same-day return payment |

## Markers that MUST appear (each quoted from the message)

| Category | Must quote |
|---|---|
| Payment shape | "deposit it right away, keep $400 as your bonus, and send $2,000 to our training coordinator" — a check the victim must return most of, same day |
| Payment shape | the payment's destination is the employer's side ("training coordinator"), money flowing *to* the job, not from it |
| Urgency | "must be completed the same day you deposit, as the certification window closes" |
| Process anomaly | a bonus paid before any work, then partly returned — no real employer recovers funds from a new hire's bonus |

## Markers that must NOT appear

- Information extraction — no SSN or credentials requested; do not invent them.

## Guards

- The report explains the check mechanism plainly (the $2,400 is fake; the $2,000 out is real) without asserting a crime — the pattern is named, the evidence quoted.
- "Great news" and the named sender are acknowledged as legitimate-looking elements, not treated as proof of safety.
